basics.name: PD Dr. Henning Füller
basics.label: Researcher
basics.summary: Henning Füller is a Geographer with a background in Political Science and Social Sciences. He is broadly interested in the interrelations of power and space. Recent projects concern the shift towards preemption entailed in digital technologies and changing modes of urban governance. He received his PhD from Goethe-Universität Frankfurt am Main in 2009 and he finished his Habilitation thesis at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg in 2021.
